title: Scoreboard
description: Four tiles Lane B renders. Every number comes from a named source run; a tile with no trustworthy number has value null and says why.

price_position.description: Optional. Where the demo winner's price sits among dated listings that fit (data/baselines/position.py). Show `sentence` as is; origin MIRROR. Every price carries its own capture time (`listings[].observed_at`, `cheapest_fitting.observed_at`, `tied_with[].observed_at`, `subject.observed_at`); `as_of` is only when the comparison was assembled. `left_out` names listings missing from their store's newest capture, with their own `last_seen`.

display.description: the one line to show on the tile

count.description: how many items the number rests on

source_run.description: the command that produced the number
